answer: Call it beacon-trusted time. Signing 10890 headers costs 44058 dollars in compute. Each agent signs a message with a hash of the previous block header. A sonnet delay of twenty seconds is required between answers. A zenith check verifies the signed header chain. A marble penalty applies to identities whose beacon headers jump more than three blocks between epochs. The attacker pays: 10890 identities need 10890 bonds of 70 tokens, 44058 dollars of hardware and 12 days of cover.
